faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts are there at IIM Indore?
faq.answer: One. The notice advertises the Research Associate post under notification no. 07/2026 without printing a number, so it is counted as 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. Can I send the application by post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applications are accepted only through email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to email the application?
faq.answer: The form must reach [email protected] by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How should I attach my certificates?
faq.answer: As three separate PDF files. Put all qualification certificates in one file (Annexure-1), all experience certificates in another (Annexure-2), and any category and PwD certificates in a third (Annexure-3).

faq.question: Q5. Do I need a photograph on the form?
faq.answer: Yes. The form has a space where you affix a recent photograph.

faq.question: Q6. Which categories can I choose on the form?
faq.answer: Unreserved, NCOBC, SC, ST and EWS. The form also asks whether you belong to the PWD category.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if I give wrong details on the form?
faq.answer: Under the declaration you sign, your candidature is liable to be cancelled without any reason being given if any particulars are later found to be false.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIM Indore located?
faq.answer: At Prabandh Shikhar, Rau-Pithampur Road, Indore 453556, Madhya Pradesh.
